questions.question: Which type of rotor of three phase induction motor has slip rings?
questions.explanation: Phase wound rotor is also called slip ring rotor. It uses slip rings for external rotor connection.
explanationLines: Phase wound rotor is also called slip ring rotor.
It uses slip rings for external rotor connection.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: The key difference between the synchronous speed and the actual speed of an induction motor is called
questions.explanation: The source defines slip as the difference between synchronous and rotor speed. It is important for induction motor action.
explanationLines: The source defines slip as the difference between synchronous and rotor speed.
It is important for induction motor action.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: If an induction machine runs at above synchronous speed then machine acts as
questions.explanation: The source says induction machine generates when running above synchronous speed. Then rotor speed is greater than synchronous speed.
explanationLines: The source says induction machine generates when running above synchronous speed.
Then rotor speed is greater than synchronous speed.

questions.question: In equivalent circuit of three phase induction machine X2 denotes
questions.explanation: In the source equivalent circuit, X2 is rotor reactance. It belongs to the rotor branch of the machine.
explanationLines: In the source equivalent circuit, X2 is rotor reactance.
It belongs to the rotor branch of the machine.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which speed control method is not applicable for squirrel cage induction motor?
questions.explanation: Rotor rheostat needs external rotor resistance. Squirrel cage rotor has no slip rings for that connection.
explanationLines: Rotor rheostat needs external rotor resistance.
Squirrel cage rotor has no slip rings for that connection.

questions.question: Rotating magnetic field is produced in a
questions.explanation: The source explains rotating magnetic field in three phase induction motor. Three phase supply produces the rotating field.
explanationLines: The source explains rotating magnetic field in three phase induction motor.
Three phase supply produces the rotating field.

questions.question: If synchronous speed of three phase induction motor is 1800 rpm then what may be the speed of rotor
questions.explanation: In motor operation, rotor speed is slightly less than synchronous speed. 1785 rpm is below 1800 rpm, so it is possible.
explanationLines: In motor operation, rotor speed is slightly less than synchronous speed.
1785 rpm is below 1800 rpm, so it is possible.

questions.question: The stator core of the induction motor is made up of
questions.explanation: The source gives laminated silicon steel stampings for stator core. This reduces iron losses in the stator.
explanationLines: The source gives laminated silicon steel stampings for stator core.
This reduces iron losses in the stator.

questions.question: In three phase induction motor the value of slip ranges from
questions.explanation: Slip is between no-load and standstill values in motor operation. The source exercise gives 0 to 1 as the correct range.
explanationLines: Slip is between no-load and standstill values in motor operation.
The source exercise gives 0 to 1 as the correct range.

questions.question: At what value of slip torque becomes maximum?
questions.explanation: The source torque-slip relation gives maximum torque at s = R2 / X2. This is the slip value for maximum torque.
explanationLines: The source torque-slip relation gives maximum torque at s = R2 / X2.
This is the slip value for maximum torque.

questions.question: Which formula is given by synchronous speed of AC motors?
questions.explanation: The source uses synchronous speed formula with frequency and poles. So Ns = 120 f / p.
explanationLines: The source uses synchronous speed formula with frequency and poles.
So Ns = 120 f / p.

questions.question: For 3 phase induction motor to operate as generator which condition should be met?
questions.explanation: The source says induction generator action occurs above synchronous speed. So rotor speed must be greater than synchronous speed.
explanationLines: The source says induction generator action occurs above synchronous speed.
So rotor speed must be greater than synchronous speed.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Three phase induction motor is also called ............
questions.explanation: The source says three phase induction motor is also called asynchronous motor. Its rotor does not normally run at synchronous speed.
explanationLines: The source says three phase induction motor is also called asynchronous motor.
Its rotor does not normally run at synchronous speed.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: In induction motor, power is transferred from stator to rotor by ............
questions.explanation: The source says power is transferred through induction. The stator acts like primary and rotor like secondary.
explanationLines: The source says power is transferred through induction.
The stator acts like primary and rotor like secondary.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: In induction motor transformer analogy, stator acts as ............
questions.explanation: The source compares induction motor with transformer action. It says stator works as the primary.
explanationLines: The source compares induction motor with transformer action.
It says stator works as the primary.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: In induction motor transformer analogy, rotor acts as ............
questions.explanation: The source says the rotor works as secondary. Induced current flows in the rotor circuit.
explanationLines: The source says the rotor works as secondary.
Induced current flows in the rotor circuit.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which is a feature of three phase induction motor?
questions.explanation: The source lists simple design as a feature. It also states robust construction and low price.
explanationLines: The source lists simple design as a feature.
It also states robust construction and low price.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which is another feature of three phase induction motor?
questions.explanation: The source says three phase induction motor is robust. This is why it is widely used industrially.
explanationLines: The source says three phase induction motor is robust.
This is why it is widely used industrially.

questions.question: The speed of three phase induction motor depends mainly on ............
questions.explanation: The source says speed depends on frequency of power source. Synchronous speed is related to frequency and poles.
explanationLines: The source says speed depends on frequency of power source.
Synchronous speed is related to frequency and poles.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which are the main parts of a three phase induction motor?
questions.explanation: The source lists stator and rotor as main parts. The stator is stationary and rotor rotates.
explanationLines: The source lists stator and rotor as main parts.
The stator is stationary and rotor rotates.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: The stator is the ............ part of induction motor.
questions.explanation: The source describes stator as the stationary part. It carries the three phase stator winding.
explanationLines: The source describes stator as the stationary part.
It carries the three phase stator winding.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: The rotor is the ............ part of induction motor.
questions.explanation: The source describes the rotor inside the stator. It rotates due to electromagnetic torque.
explanationLines: The source describes the rotor inside the stator.
It rotates due to electromagnetic torque.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which rotor has copper or aluminium bars short-circuited by end rings?
questions.explanation: The source explains squirrel cage rotor construction. Rotor bars are short-circuited by end rings.
explanationLines: The source explains squirrel cage rotor construction.
Rotor bars are short-circuited by end rings.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which rotor allows external resistance in rotor circuit?
questions.explanation: The source states slip ring rotor has external connections. External resistance can be added through slip rings.
explanationLines: The source states slip ring rotor has external connections.
External resistance can be added through slip rings.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which rotor is simpler and more rugged?
questions.explanation: The source compares squirrel cage and slip ring rotors. Squirrel cage type is simpler and robust.
explanationLines: The source compares squirrel cage and slip ring rotors.
Squirrel cage type is simpler and robust.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which rotor has higher starting torque using external resistance?
questions.explanation: External rotor resistance can improve starting torque. This is possible in slip ring induction motor.
explanationLines: External rotor resistance can improve starting torque.
This is possible in slip ring induction motor.

questions.question: What is synchronous speed?
questions.explanation: The source explains synchronous speed as speed of rotating magnetic field. It depends on supply frequency and number of poles.
explanationLines: The source explains synchronous speed as speed of rotating magnetic field.
It depends on supply frequency and number of poles.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: What is rotor speed?
questions.explanation: The source distinguishes rotor speed from synchronous speed. Rotor speed is the real rotating speed of motor rotor.
explanationLines: The source distinguishes rotor speed from synchronous speed.
Rotor speed is the real rotating speed of motor rotor.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: In motor operation, rotor speed is normally ............ synchronous speed.
questions.explanation: Induction motor needs slip to induce rotor current. So rotor speed is slightly below synchronous speed.
explanationLines: Induction motor needs slip to induce rotor current.
So rotor speed is slightly below synchronous speed.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: If rotor speed becomes equal to synchronous speed, slip becomes ............
questions.explanation: Slip is based on difference between synchronous and rotor speed. Equal speeds make that difference zero.
explanationLines: Slip is based on difference between synchronous and rotor speed.
Equal speeds make that difference zero.

questions.question: Why is slip necessary in induction motor?
options: To induce rotor emf and current
questions.correctOption: To induce rotor emf and current
questions.explanation: Without slip, there is no relative speed between field and rotor. The source links rotor current with induction action.
explanationLines: Without slip, there is no relative speed between field and rotor.
The source links rotor current with induction action.

questions.question: What produces rotor current in an induction motor?
questions.explanation: The source says rotor current is produced by induction. Changing field cuts rotor conductors and induces emf.
explanationLines: The source says rotor current is produced by induction.
Changing field cuts rotor conductors and induces emf.

questions.question: The operating principle of induction motor is based on ............
questions.explanation: The source explains transformer-like induction action. Rotor emf is induced by the rotating magnetic field.
explanationLines: The source explains transformer-like induction action.
Rotor emf is induced by the rotating magnetic field.

questions.question: What is the result of rotor current interacting with rotating magnetic field?
questions.explanation: The source explains torque production in induction motor. This torque makes the rotor rotate.

This torque makes the rotor rotate.

questions.question: Which part carries three phase supply in an induction motor?

It produces the rotating magnetic field.

So R1 represents stator resistance.

It explains how motor torque changes with slip.

questions.question: At starting of induction motor, slip is nearly ............
